reserveReview.rationale: Enosys Loans is a Liquity V2 friendly fork whose documented collateral branches are FXRP, WFLR, stXRP, and sFLR, priced by the Flare Time Series Oracle. The configured on-chain adapter's branch snapshot resolves all four live collateral rows and supplies the point-in-time weights; those weights remain dynamic and are not treated as permanent composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Enosys Loans documented collateral branches and the configured Flare branch snapshot (live-reserves capture of 2026-07-19); percentages rounded to one decimal
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material collateral row is unclassified in this snapshot; branch weights are point-in-time and shift with trove activity.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral sits in on-chain branch contracts of the Liquity V2 fork rather than with a conventional custodian; legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation terms do not apply to the non-custodial contracts, whose integrity and FTSO pricing are the operative risks.
